bugs.name: Public repository filters include repositories labeled Internal
bugs.summary: The Public repository filter includes repositories marked Internal.
bugs.expected: The Public filter should show only public repositories.
bugs.actual: The Public repository filter includes repositories marked Internal.
reproSteps: Create a disposable Internal repository alongside the seeded public repository.
Open Explore > Repositories and select Filter > Public.
Observe the Internal repository remains in the list; repeat under Admin > Repositories if available.

bugs.name: Explore search retains a hidden topic filter after replacing the query
bugs.summary: After a topic facet is selected, replacing the repository search query can retain an invisible topic constraint and hide a matching repository.
bugs.expected: Replacing the search query should clear or reveal any retained topic filter.
bugs.actual: After a topic facet is selected, replacing the repository search query can retain an invisible topic constraint and hide a matching repository.
reproSteps: Create a disposable public repository with a unique name and topic.
Find it in Explore > Repositories and select its topic facet.
Replace the query with the repository name and submit.
Observe an empty result while the topic parameter remains active; clear filters and check whether it is removed.

bugs.name: Selecting an Explore topic resets the selected repository sort
bugs.summary: Selecting a topic facet resets an independently selected Alphabetically repository sort to Recently updated.
bugs.expected: Selecting a topic should preserve the chosen repository sort.
bugs.actual: Selecting a topic facet resets an independently selected Alphabetically repository sort to Recently updated.
reproSteps: Create or find repositories with a shared topic.
In Explore > Repositories, search for them and select Sort > Alphabetically.
Select a visible topic facet from a result.
Open Sort again and observe that Recently updated is selected and the alphabetic sort parameter is gone.
